description: This script provides a command-line tool for categorizing commit entries, optionally using a machine learning classifier. It defines a Categorizer class that loads commit data, applies classification, and interacts with the user to assign categories and topics to commits.

classes.name: Categorizer
classes.description: A class that manages commit categorization, including loading data, applying classifiers, and user interaction for categorization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Categorizer with commit data, optionally loads a classifier, and sets the default category.

methods.name: categorize
methods.description: Iterates over commits in the specified category and handles user interaction for categorization.

methods.name: features
methods.description: Retrieves cached features for a given commit.

methods.name: potential_reverts_of
methods.description: Identifies potential revert commits related to a given commit.

methods.name: handle_commit
methods.description: Handles user interaction for categorizing a single commit, including classifier prediction and input prompts.

methods.name: update_commit
methods.description: Updates the commit with new category and topic and writes the result.
